title: Spotify's is giving you the keys to its recommendation algorithm with US launch of 'Taste Profile' | TechCrunch
summary: The music streaming giant on Wednesday began rolling out a feature called “Taste Profile” to its Premium subscribers in the U.S. that allows users to see, for the first time, how Spotify understands their taste across music and other audio.
